author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Provides named, configurable, privacy-conscious cross-platform points for chat consistency, observed active/lurk time, and supported community events.
changelog: 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: added creator-named currency, source-routed balance lookup, chat consistency, observation-based active/lurk time, configurable event awards, and bounded multi-platform session settlement. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial foundation slice with installation-local pseudonyms, explicit stable-ID account links, fixed point awards, chat cooldowns, replay protection, bounded private state, a permission/dependency-gated broker service, and authenticated wizard status, export, correction, and deletion operations.

manifest.name: Viewer Foundation
installationSteps: Install Viewer Foundation in the wizard and review its private-state permission.
Optionally add explicit account links using viewer-id|platform|stable-user-id. Never link accounts by display name.
Name the currency and choose chat, consistency, observed time, lurk, and event awards; then save and restart StreamBridge.
Create the Viewer Foundation balance command in Command Sync so viewers can use !points.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its pseudonymous progression state remains preserved for a later reinstall or privacy export.

healthChecks.description: Confirms named currency, salted identity resolution, bounded chat/time/event awards, replay protection, and atomic private progression state.
